hard_gates.neighbor_plateau: candidate cluster type must equal PLATEAU_SUPPORTED
hard_gates.cost_stress: aggregate severe net R > 0 and severe PF > 1.0
hard_gates.annual_consistency: among full years 2018-2025, at least 7 of 8 central net-R years > 0; 2026 partial is diagnostic only
hard_gates.cpcv: all 28 combinations of two OOS semiannual folds from 2022H1-2025H2 must have severe net R > 0
hard_gates.monte_carlo_block5: 20000 moving-block bootstrap trajectories on severe R, block length 5 trades; net-R p05 > 0
hard_gates.bootstrap_years: 10000 bootstrap trajectories resampling the eight full source-clock years 2018-2025 with replacement using severe annual net R; net-R p05 > 0
hard_gates.random_execution_failures_10pct: 10000 Bernoulli missed-execution trajectories on severe R; net-R p05 > 0
hard_gates.random_execution_failures_20pct: 10000 Bernoulli missed-execution trajectories on severe R; net-R p05 > 0
hard_gates.best_2p5pct_removed: remove ceil(2.5% of trades) ranked by severe R descending; remaining severe net R > 0
hard_gates.best_5pct_removed: remove ceil(5% of trades) ranked by severe R descending; remaining severe net R > 0
hard_gates.leave_one_year_out: for each full source-clock year 2018-2025, remove that year and require remaining severe net R > 0

provenance: Thresholds are imported prospectively from mandatory QROS Supergate invariants and prior accepted XAU/NQX Supergate conventions; they were frozen before running V92 statistics. CPCV uses the stricter prior precedent of all combinatorial paths positive rather than inventing a post-result percentile cutoff.
